rv.q: A cute and peppy kids' show with great puppets, but even at his gentlest, Dahl without the dark streak doesn't feel quite right.
This is a production which combines dazzling puppetry, witty lyrics, exuberant music and inspired staging into a family show which feels both faithful to Dahl and brimming with theatrical magic.
Fabulously funny, with snappy songs, perfect puppetry and a sensational cast
Definitely a snappy performance that sends the kids away grinning from ear to ear.
It’s filled with wee, fart and bottom jokes.
A very successful 55-minute version of this classic picture book, which was rapturously received

cn.t: This vibrant Roald Dahl adaptation delights with colorful design, infectious songs, and energetic performances that entertain the whole family, though some critics note it lacks the menace of the original story.
